commands_run: source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 16.19.1 && cd /workspace && npm ci
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 16.19.1 && cd /workspace && npx gulp deploy
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && cd /workspace/web-react && npm ci && npm run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173
cd /workspace/e2e-comparison && npm ci && npx playwright install && npx playwright test
notes: Angular reference is the Gulp-built AngularJS app served by `gulp express` on port 9001 (see gulpfile.js).
React migration shell is Vite in `web-react/` on port 5173; it syncs `dist/` into `web-react/public/legacy` and embeds Angular via iframe (`LegacyFrame.tsx`).
`dist/` was generated with `npx gulp deploy` for this audit; `conf.json` targets API at http://localhost:9000 (backend optional for static meta / shell structure checks).
Migration PR branch and audit branch currently point to the same commit in this clone (merge-base equals HEAD).

Angular tests use e2e-comparison/scripts/serve-angular-dist.mjs instead of gulp express: gulp's version = v-Date.now() on each process start mismatches TAIGA_VERSION baked into dist/index.html, which breaks /{version}/locales/*.json loads.
